rationale.colonization: 山地探索存在，但海外殖民不是核心。
rationale.complexity: 大战、防御、公会、工业与种姓事务交错。
rationale.dark_story: 战争创伤和强制劳动构成真实阴暗内容。
rationale.difficulty: 需要防御与反攻时机判断，未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 罗阇那陀伽友邦及边防属国有重要作用。
rationale.early_pressure: 近邻命令秩序拥有压倒性体量。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 英雄与工艺并存，魔奇不是唯一主线。
rationale.narrative_density: 守城、归乡、跨族身份与劳役改革构成连续转折。
rationale.tall_play: 防御、矿业、煤炭与工坊需要长期投入。
rationale.trade_economy: 金属、煤炭和技术交流形成后期产业。
rationale.warfare: 命令秩序威胁与反攻是初段主轴。

identity.appearance: 1444对抗命令秩序的英雄领域王国
identity.formation_scope: 符合英雄领域及地区条件后可形成R97罗伽禅地；R11任务使用is_or_was_tag，允许换Tag后继续；英雄大捷可豁免一处通常所需核心省

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 在大地精司令部的入侵中，傲慢的沙摩朅诸王国一个接一个地倒下，佉地悉罗补罗也和它的表亲一样，组织混乱。由于离心贵族和叛国贼子的影响，佉地悉罗补罗军队面对大地精迅速和压倒性的推进节节败退。即便如此，佉地悉罗补罗军队还是殊死搏斗，从大地精的手中保住了首都。如今，佉地悉罗补罗成了第一次大地精入侵的最后堡垒，室利早已在怪物手里倾覆，而知罗祉也沦落成了萨那繁的后院。佉地悉罗补罗的军队必须保卫失去家园的妇女和从未见过父亲的孩子！荣誉感和同情心定义了佉地悉罗补罗的人民，他们宁愿死也不愿蒙受屈辱！在佉地悉罗补罗，有能者尽皆手持武器，奔赴战场。既是为了荣誉，也为了他们的同胞！
description.text_en: During the invasion of the Hobgoblin Command, arrogant Shamakhadi Kingdoms fell one after the other, and Khadisrapur was as disorganized as its cousins. Facing rebellious nobles and traitors, the army of Khadisrapur stood little chance against the swift and overwhelming advance of the hobgoblins. Even so, Khadisrapur's armies fought tooth and nail to keep the capital out of Hobgoblin hands. As it stands Khadisrapur is the last remnant of the first invasion, even Sir has fallen to the monsters and what remains of Tilathi is little more than Sarnavan's backyard. The armies of Khadisrapur must defend the women who have lost their homes and the children who have never seen their fathers! In Khadisrapur, honor and compassion are what define the people, they would rather die than see this humiliation! Any man capable of wielding a blade shall fight. For Honor and for the sake of their own kind!

description.text: 争吵不休的波罗部和罗阇国的大臣们永远无法鼓起足够的意志力，团结一致，与信仰兄弟们并肩作战。然而，有许多冒险家、旅行者、诗人和艺术家在我们反对野蛮的斗争中找到了灵感。他们的故事、诗歌和画作激发了南方许多富有的贵族支持我们的事业，也为佉地悉罗补罗赢得了罗阇的同情。应该充分利用这一机会，并与南方的潜在盟友建立进一步的外交联系。
description.text_en: The bickering Prabhia and Ministers of the Raj could never muster enough willpower to stand united and fight beside their brethren in faith. There are, however, many Adventurers, Travellers, Poets, and Artists who find inspiration in the fight against barbarity and savagery. Their stories, poems, and depictions have inspired many wealthy noblemen in the south to support the cause and it has earned Khadisrapur the sympathy of the Raja. This opportunity should be used to its fullest extent and further diplomatic connections should be pursued with potential allies in the south.

description.text: 佉地悉罗补罗称之为家的地区原本就已声名远扬；沙摩朅北部一带遍布着古老的废墟和建筑，因此一些学者将该地区内的国家称为「废墟王国」。1431年，当大地精入侵时，该地区的各领主和王国们都无法做出有效的反应。入侵的军队纪律严明，组织严密……而且毫不留情。我们最终真正成为了「废墟王国」，城市被摧毁，民众被迫沦为难民，在耻辱的境遇中苟且度日，那些伟大的图书馆也化为乌有……这赋予了佉地悉罗补罗一份对沙摩朅人民的使命和责任。必须把大地精赶回他们的山丘洞穴，因为人类的荣誉和尊严危在旦夕。佉地悉罗补罗必将光复，继而重建，哪怕是那些古老的废墟也一样，被称为「废墟王国」的耻辱也将永远随着勇敢的佉地悉罗补罗人民的鲜血和泪水一并被洗刷掉！
description.text_en: The region Khadisrapur calls home already had a reputation; the area around northern Shamakhad is dotted with old derelict ruins and structures, hence the reason why some scholars refer to the states within the region as 'Ruin Kingdoms'. When the Hobgoblins invaded in 1431, the different lordships and kingdoms of the region could not respond in an effective manner. The invading armies were well-disciplined and organized... and showed no mercy. A ''Ruin Kingdom'' is what we truly became, the cities were destroyed, the people were forced to live in disgraceful conditions as refugees, and the great libraries were lost... This leaves Khadisrapur with a mission, and a duty, toward the people of Shamakhad. The Hobgoblins must be beaten back to their hills and caves, for the honor of all humankind is at stake. Khadisrapur will be reclaimed, and then it shall be rebuilt, even the ruins of old, and the shame of being called a "ruin kingdom" shall forever be washed away with the blood and tears of the brave people of Khadisrapur once and for all!

description.text:
背叛自己的盟友是最为怯懦的行为。当王国遭受攻击时，民众四处逃散，兄弟相继离世，政府陷入混乱时，佉地悉罗补罗抛弃了它的朋友吗？没有！当知罗祉呼唤时，佉地悉罗补罗前来应答，而在那场名为那迦兰之战的战役中，两个王国联合起来打破了大地精不可战胜的神话。佉地悉罗补罗有没有要求任何回报？没有！因为这从来都是契陀利驮人的生活方式——有朋友身处困境便会挺身而出保护他们。这就是契陀利驮人对待邻居的作法，以荣誉相敬，以赤诚相待，以尊重相交。

这份情谊不仅存在于我们和老邻居之间，与新邻居之间也同样存在。大地精敌意的受害者中，也包括与我们发生激烈冲突的雷拳兽人——他们被迫听命于入侵者，在战争中毫无选择余地。即便如此，他们在战场上仍表现出荣誉感，避免不必要的杀戮和掠夺，不像他们的血歌族同伴那样。无论是在战争时期还是和平时期，是战俘还是不情愿的邻居，这些兽人都被证明可以成为好邻居，并为生下新一代混血但延续荣誉和怜悯传统的契陀利驮人做出贡献。
description.text_en:
To forsake your allies is the most cowardly of acts. When the realm was under attack, the people losing their brethren left and right, and the government in disarray, did Khadisrapur forsake its friends? No! When Tilathi called, Khadisrapur was there to answer, and at the Battle of Naraka the myth of Hobgoblin invincibility was broken by the combined forces of the two kingdoms. Did Khadisrapur demand any compensation? No! For this has never been the way that the Khedarid people have lived - Khadisrapur knew a friend in need and rushed to protect them. Such is the way of the Khedarid, who honor, love, and respect their neighbor.

These feelings extend to both old neighbors and new. Among the victims of Hobgoblin hostility are the Thunderfist orcs with whom we clashed so fiercely - they were forced to do the bidding of the invader, given no choice in the war. Even then they showed honor in arms, avoiding unnecessary killing and pillaging, unlike their Bloodsong counterparts. In war and peace, as prisoners and grudging neighbors, the orcs have been proven good neighbors, and contribute to a new generation of mixed-blood Khedarid who continue the tradition of honor and compassion.

description.text:
佉地悉罗补罗王国及其同名的首都依偎在资源丰富但危险的蛇脊山脉阴影下。得益于铁器生产，羯罗同具罗周边是整个罗祆铁矿石产量最为丰富的地区之一，许多以前曾作为奴隶兵为命令秩序效力的兽人，如今在矿场工作，与当地民众建立联系，并最终在该地区形成半兽人工人阶层。

在命令秩序的阴影下，未工业化的佉地悉罗补罗只能依靠基本的工具，并且只有少数专家能够对土地资源情况有大致了解，因此很难利用自己的资源优势。但随着先进采矿技术的不断普及，越来越多来自罗佉提湿的人类专家对佉地悉罗补罗的矿藏产生了兴趣，开始提供服务并效仿犍计阗矿场的模式以改善生产。两个因素的结合不仅为佉地悉罗补罗，也为整个沙摩朅贸易圈开启了工业时代。
description.text_en:
The realm of Khadisrapur and its eponymous capital nestle in the shadow of the resource-rich but dangerous Serpentspine mountains. The area around Kradhungur is one of the richest areas in all of Rahen when it comes to Iron production, and many Orcs who previously fought as slave soldiers for the command found themselves working in the mines and forming connections with the local populace, eventually giving rise to a working-class half-orcish population in some areas.

Under the shadow of the Command, using basic tools, and with few experts to get a better lay of the land, a pre-industrial Khadisrapur struggled to take advantage of her resources. As advancements in mining spread, an increasing number of human experts from Rakhadesh took interest in the mines of Khadisrapur and offered their services to improve production on the model of the Ghankedhen mines. The combination of these two causes would kickstart the industrial era not only for Khadisrapur but for the entirety of the Shamakhadi trading sphere as well.

description.text:
「向西走，多罗阇省曾经是佉地悉罗补罗领地的最东边的地区。多罗阇的气候是相当多样的，取决于你在一年中的什么时候来这里——在冬天，空气的干燥和来自蛇脊山脉的风使人感到刺骨的寒冷，但如果坚持沿河西行，湿度会慢慢增加，天气会变得更舒适。人们总是可以选择一些商队所走的沙漠捷径，但要注意，沙漠的温度在白天和晚上会有很大的不同。一旦你到耆罗朅农业镇，在这处著名的商队目的地进行修整补给是明智的行为。

当你准备出发时，再次向西走，并询问坡跋矿区的情况——契陀利驮人在指路方面相当有帮助。当你到达坡跋时，到当地的铁匠那里购买一些质量不错的武器，然后沿着道路向北走，找到前往摩楼伐的路，这个省曾经是大地精命令秩序的核心。在这里，为你自己购买此地精质羊毛做成的冬装，并准备登上神壁，因为你已经接近你的目标——佉楼若那大瀑布，以及它之后的土地......」

节选自《嫩许兰之旅——冒险家指南》——亚瑟里安·古塔，1755年
description.text_en:
"Moving west, the province of Taraja was once the easternmost region of the lordship of Khadisrapur. The climate in Taraja is quite different depending on what time of the year you decide to visit - in the winter, the dryness of the air and the winds from the Serpentspine make for a bone-chilling combination, but if one sticks to the riverside and moves steadily westwards, the humidity slowly increases and the weather becomes somewhat more pleasant. One can always choose the desert shortcut that some caravans take, but be warned that the desert can have radically different temperatures between day and night. Once you reach the agricultural town of Ghilakhad, it is advisable to resupply at the prominent caravan destination.

When you are ready to move out, head west again and ask for the Phabar mines - the Khedarid are quite helpful when it comes to giving directions. When you reach Phabar, visit the local blacksmith for some decent-quality weaponry, then take the road north and find your way to Maruvad, a province once core to the Great Hobgoblin Command. Here, buy your winter clothing from their excellent wool products, and prepare to make your ascent up the Godswall, for you are close to your goal - the Great Waterfall of Kharunyana, and the lands above it..."

An excerpt from 'Journey to Nomsyulhan - An Adventurer's Guide' - Arthurian Oldtower, 1755

description.text: 佉地悉罗补罗的土地与神壁、这个与佉楼若那瀑布相邻的巨大悬崖以及通往蛇脊山脉之外的神秘高原的狭窄通道相接。多年来，世界上流传着许多关于这片传奇土地的谣言和传说，声称那里有着大量的宝藏和神秘的居民，但真相始终不可知。尽管如此，许多冒险家都渴望在远方的土地上获得新的荣耀，因此他们聚集在佉地悉罗补罗，准备向远方探险。他们的准备工作选在摩楼伐塔进行的，这座伟大的堡垒是为了防止来自未知高原的入侵，也是为了防止来自北方的进犯军队，比如曾经出其不意地攻占佉地悉罗补罗的大地精。
description.text_en: Khadisrapur's lands border the Godswall, the great cliffs that abut the Kharunyana waterfall and the narrow pathways to the mysterious plateaus beyond the Serpentspine. Over the years, many rumors and legends about this legendary land have circulated around the world, claiming great treasures and mysterious people who populate it, the truth of such things is unknowable. Many adventurers are nonetheless eager for new glories in the lands beyond, and so congregate in Khadisrapur to prepare their expeditions into the beyond. These preparations take place at the Maruvad Tower, the great fortress built to guard against incursions both from the unknown plateaus and also against advancing armies from the north, like the hobgoblins that once took Khadisrapur by surprise.

description.text:
流场之战是一个历史性的转折点，冒险者和北方军队在此击退了罗摩波剌的进攻，确保了北方持久的主权。在流淌之野的广袤土地上，一场激烈的战略和力量较量正在展开，这不仅是为了争夺领土，更是为了争夺北方王国的精髓——独特文化和坚定自治的嵌合体。罗摩波剌纪律严明的军团以前从未受到过挑战，现在有可能吞噬北方。然而，从普通的队伍中涌现出了英雄——出身各异的冒险家，他们以新发现的决心团结北方的军队。

随后的冲突是无情的。这些冒险家运用新颖的战术，挫败了罗摩波剌的进军。他们的英勇将平原变成了不可逾越的屏障，扰乱了敌人的阵线，造成了混乱。最终，他们的统一战线和英勇无畏捍卫了北方的自治。这场胜利如今已成为传奇，它证明了团结的力量和勇敢的力量，确保了北方所珍视的自由得以保留，这也是那些英勇的卫士们牺牲的遗产。
description.text_en:
The Battle of The Flowing Fields marks a historic pivot, where adventurers and northern forces repelled Ramapalar’s onslaught, securing the north’s enduring sovereignty. On the Flowing Fields’ expanse, a fierce contest of strategy and strength unfolded, not just for territory, but for the northern realms’ essence—a mosaic of distinct cultures and staunch autonomy. Rampalar’s disciplined legions, previously unchallenged, threatened to engulf the north. Yet, from common ranks arose heroes—adventurers of varied origins, rallying the northern armies with a newfound resolve.

The ensuing conflict was relentless. These adventurers, wielding novel tactics, thwarted Rampalar’s march. Their valor transformed the plains into an insurmountable barrier, disrupting enemy lines and instilling disarray. Ultimately, their united front and bravery safeguarded the north’s self-rule. This triumph, now legendary, is a testament to unity’s might and bravery’s strength, ensuring the north’s cherished liberty remains, a legacy of those valiant defenders’ sacrifice.

description.text:
沙摩朅织物已经融入了东洲的肌理。在拉格哈詹迪广袤的平原上，他们的织布机嗡嗡作响，生产出如月光般闪亮的丝绸、如母亲的怀抱般柔软的棉布，以及让人倍感温暖的羊毛。这些纤维跨越国界，将文化和经济联系在一起。沙摩朅的工匠们用他们饱经风霜的巧手，讲述着坚韧不拔和精湛技艺的故事。从宫廷到陋室，他们的作品披在肩上，装饰墙壁，引人入梦。

在挫败了命令秩序之后，北方通过其精湛的纺织技术，准备在整个大陆编织自己的霸业。新一代工匠崭露头角，准备在历史上留下自己的印记，他们重建作坊，交织线头，为生活注入活力，同时向沙摩朅过去的工匠们致敬。
description.text_en:
Shamakhadi Fabrics had woven themselves into the very fabric of Haless. Across the vast plains of Raghajandi, their looms hummed with industry, producing silks that shimmered like moonlight, cottons as soft as a mother’s embrace, and wool that cradled warmth. These fibers traversed borders, binding cultures and economies. The artisans of Shamakhad, their hands skilled and weathered, spun tales of resilience and craftsmanship. From royal courts to humble homes, their creations draped shoulders, adorned walls, and induced sweet dreams.

Having thwarted the Great Command, the North stands poised to weave its dominance across the continent through its textile mastery. A new generation of artisans emerges, ready to stitch their mark on history, as they rebuild workshops, intertwine threads, and infuse life with vibrant hues, all while honoring the venerable legacy of Shamakhadi’s past craftsmen.

description.text:
北部河畔因大量虎人的居住而变得丰富多彩，长期以来一直是自由和创新的摇篮。从诃利秣大帝时代到象渡城和佉萨度罗统治时期，这些土地见证了帝国的兴衰。它们曾经只是诃利秣罗阇军团的宿营地，后来发展成为充满活力的定居点。虎人帝国崩溃后，这些城市成为了抵御混乱的先锋，以帝国的荣誉捍卫着北方领土。

佉萨度罗王国在寻找合法统治者的过程中，看到了虎人的持久精神。对他们来说，这片土地是神圣的，是诃利秣本人的信任，迫使他们去培育、捍卫和尊重它。将他们长达千年的遗产——先进的管理和军事智慧赋予当地民众。北方虎人的贡献——无论是行政创新还是战术教育——仍然是该地区不可或缺的财富。
description.text_en:
The northern riversides, enriched by a substantial Harimari populace, have long been a cradle of liberty and innovation. Throughout the ages, from the era of Harimar the Great to the reigns of Sparathi and Khasardul, these lands have witnessed the ebb and flow of empires. Once mere encampments for Harimraj’s legions, they flourished into vibrant settlements. Following the collapse of the Harimari Empire, these cities became the vanguard against disorder, safeguarding the northern territories in the empire’s honor.

The kingdom of Khasardul, amidst its search for a rightful ruler, saw the enduring spirit of the Harimari. To them, the land is hallowed, a trust from Harimar himself, compelling them to nurture, defend, and honor it. Their millennium-long legacy includes empowering the local populace with advanced governance and military acumen. The Northern Harimari’s contributions—be it administrative innovations or tactical education—remain an indispensable asset to the region.

description.text:
北方在其黄金时代曾是一个史诗故事的王国，响彻整个大陆。在这里，不仅流传着传奇故事，而且生生不息——从高高的草地到连绵起伏的山丘，都在讲述着英勇的英雄及其不朽的事迹。

这些故事充满了这片土地辉煌历史的壮丽，被广为流传，点燃了整个东洲人民的想象力。平原上的英雄们——罗伽禅地的英雄们，他们的英勇事迹成为传奇，在每个角落都被传颂，他们的名字是勇气和荣誉的代名词。他们的事迹被载入史册，继续激励着那些渴望非凡生活、渴望成为传奇的人们......
description.text_en:
The North, during its golden age, was a realm of epic stories that resonated throughout the continent. It was a place where legends were not just spun, but lived—where the tales of gallant heroes and their monumental deeds were recounted from tall grass fields to the rolling hills.

These stories, imbued with the grandeur of the land’s illustrious past, were shared far and wide, igniting the imaginations of people across Haless. The heroes of the plains -those of Raghajandi- whose daring acts became the stuff of legend, were celebrated in every corner, their names synonymous with courage and honor. Their legacy, preserved in the annals of time, continues to inspire those who yearn for a life extraordinary and aspire to become a legend...

description.text:
在困难时期，契陀利驮人是北方王国的心脏和灵魂。他们随时准备响应号召，奋起反抗企图剥夺自由、实施暴政的邪恶势力。无论是反抗罗汉婆罗延的邪恶，还是作为英雄主义的最后堡垒对抗命令秩序的压倒性力量，契陀利驮人都坚决捍卫自由。

他们的英勇事迹被写进了一首千古传唱的颂歌中：

「在罗伽禅地的传奇之地
契陀利驮人站住了脚
『快快起来，勇悍之子』他们喊道，
在警惕的天空下
他们心潮澎湃，斗志昂扬
讲述他们的英勇故事
他们与黑暗划清界限
让自由之光闪耀。」
description.text_en:
In times of trouble, the Khedarid people stood as the heart and soul of the northern realms. They were ever-ready to heed the call to arms, rising against malevolent forces that sought to strip away freedom and impose tyranny. Whether it was the uprising against the wickedness of Lohanparayan or standing as the final bastion of heroism against the overwhelming might of the Great Command, the Khedarid were resolute in their defense of liberty.

Their valor is captured in the verses of an ode that has been sung through the ages:

In Raghajandi's storied land,
The Khedarid make their stand.
"Arise quickly, brave sons," they cry,
Under the watchful sky.
With hearts ablaze and spirits bold,
Their tales of valor are told.
Against darkness, they draw the line,
For freedom's light to shine.

description.text:
在充满传奇色彩的罗伽禅地王国，王位不是世袭的，而是通过英雄行为赢得的。登上王位的人将被安置在镜宫中，镜宫是他们英勇行为的象征，是他们统治的见证，也是王国最奢华庆典的举办地。群臣的美貌和智慧就像点缀宫殿的复杂镜面工艺一样令人着迷。

在这样的环境中，每年都会举行一次镜子节，将宫殿变成一个宏伟的中心，向所有英雄和渴望荣耀的人开放。在这个灯火辉煌的节日里，舞厅里流光溢彩，乐声悠扬，王国里最勇敢、最聪明的人都聚集在这里，展示着令人眼花缭乱的优雅。舞厅在烛光的映照下，成为讲述勇气和荣誉故事的画布。这个节日不仅仅是一个单纯的庆祝活动，更是对王国核心价值观的重申。在这个节日里，过去的遗产激励着现在的人们，敦促新一代走向伟大。在英雄国王的注视下，镜宫就像一座希望的灯塔，提醒人们拉罗伽禅地的遗产之光将永远闪耀。
description.text_en:
In the storied realm of Raghajandi, kingship is not inherited, but earned through acts of heroism. Those who rise to this high office are enthroned within the Palace of Mirrors, a symbol of their valor, a testament to their reign, and the site of the kingdom’s most extravagant celebrations. The palace’s allure is heightened by the presence of captivating courtiers, whose beauty and wit are as enchanting as the intricate mirror work that embellishes the halls.

In this setting, the Festival of Mirrors is held once each year, transforming the palace into a hub of grandeur open to all heroes and aspirants to glory. At this illuminated festival, the ballrooms swirl with color and music, a dazzling display of elegance where the kingdom’s bravest and brightest gather. The ballroom, bathed in reflected candlelight, becomes a canvas for stories of courage and honor. This festival is more than a mere celebration; it is a reaffirmation of the kingdom’s core values. It is a time when the legacy of the past inspires the present, urging a new generation toward greatness. The Palace of Mirrors, under the watchful eye of the Hero-King, stands as a beacon of hope and a reminder that the light of Raghajandi’s legacy will forever shine bright.

description.text:
大北方时代是罗祆历史上的一个决定性时期。1311年流场之战后，沙摩朅各王国保持联盟与合作精神，抵御了复兴的莲花宫廷的进一步侵略。在这个长期的联盟时期，这些王国迎来了一个以繁荣和社会流动性为特征的新时代，向南方僵化的种姓结构发起了挑战。

城市里歌舞升平，各行各业英雄辈出，英勇事迹编织成罗祆传奇。这是一个变革的时代，在这个时代，人们充满活力地追求梦想，创新精神重塑了社会。曾经只是罗祆罗阇、诃利秣罗阇和凤凰帝国穷乡僻壤的北部王国，如今已成为罗祆传奇的代名词。虽然野心家们的背信弃义会终结这个时代，大地精的命令秩序也会永远埋葬它，但在许多人的心中，大北方时代是一个更美好的时代——在自由的天空下，人类和虎人所能取得的最好成就。
description.text_en:
The Great Northern Age was a defining period in Raheni history. After the battle of the Flowing Fields in 1311, the disparate realms of Shamakhad maintained their alliance and cooperative spirit to ward off further aggression from the resurgent lotus court. This prolonged period of alliance saw a new age dawn on these realms, characterized by prosperity and social mobility, challenging the rigid caste structure of the south.

Cities buzzed with the energy of song and dance, heroes emerged from all walks of life, and deeds of bravery wove themselves into the fabric of Raheni legend. This was a time of transformation, where dreams were pursued with vigor and the spirit of innovation reshaped society. The northern realms, once mere backwater territories to the Rahenraj, the Harimraj, and the Phoenix Empire, became synonymous with the saga of Raheni legends. Though the perfidy of ambitious men would end this age, and the hobgoblin Command bury it forever, the Great Northern Age lived in the minds of many as a better time - the best of what men and harimari could achieve under a free sky.

description.text: 罗祆北部是该地区文明的摇篮。正是在那里，第一批城市发展起来，第一批城邦变成了王国。这里是罗祆的第一任国王统治的地方。当其他人声称比我们更富有、更强大时，我们永远知道我们是罗祆最古老的国王。
description.text_en: Northern Rahen is the cradle of civilisation in the region. It is there that the first cities grew and there that the first city states became kingdoms. Here that the first high kings of Rahen ruled. While others may claim to be richer, or more powerful than us, we will always know that we are the oldest kings of Rahen.

description.text: 废墟王国被称为废墟王国有几个原因，其中一个是这里星罗棋布着许多人类文明初期的荒废城市。当然，我们也是废墟王国，因为我们已失去了大量领土。然而，当地许多贵族仍然知道他们真正的主人是谁。我们应当光复他们的土地，交还给他们真正的统治者。
description.text_en: The Ruin Kingdoms are called that for several reasons. One reason is the many ruined cities from the dawn of human civilisation that dot the landscape here. We are also the Ruin Kingdoms because we have lost a great deal of territory. However, many of the local nobility still know who their true overlords are. We shall reintegrate their lands and return them to their proper ruler.

description.text: 当罗祆罗阇对抗东洲其余地方，他们从沙摩朅王国调出了他们最精锐的军队。而且那些战争中归来的退伍军人开创了一项一直延续至今的军事传统。
description.text_en: When the Rahenraj fought their wars against the rest of Haless, they pulled their most elite troops from the kingdoms of Shamakad. The veterans from those wars came home and started a martial tradition that has lasted to this day.

description.text: 罗祆北部的图书馆不仅仅是知识的宝库。我们的图书馆也成为哲学家和发明家之间对话的场所。这使得我们不仅可以储存知识，还可以扩展知识。
description.text_en: The libraries of northern Rahen are not mere stores of knowledge. We have made our libraries a place for dialogue between philosophers and inventors as well. This has allowed us to not merely store knowledge, but expand it too.

description.text: 我们的宫廷和土地拥有许多家族，他们的血统可以追溯到古代的国王甚至在那帝摩罗阇之前。这些家庭拥有我们应该利用的知识和力量。让我们加强他们的特权，这样他们就会给予我们援助作为回报。
description.text_en: Our court and lands hold many families whose bloodlines go back to ancient kings from before even the Nadimraj. These families have knowledge and power that we should exploit. Let us strengthen their privileges so that they may give us their aid in return.

description.text: 曾经，在遥远的过去，当我们去打仗时，我们把矛和剑交给了我们的工匠，我们的农民和我们的商人。然而，这些人对我们的经济是必不可少的，他们也不能花他们的一生为战争训练。所以我们用国王和贵族个人拥有的奴隶来打仗作为替代。
description.text_en: Once, in the distant past, when we went to war we put spears and swords into the hands of our craftsmen, our farmers and our merchants. However those people are essential for our economy, neither can they spend their life training for war. So instead we use a class of slaves that are personally owned by our kings and nobles to fight our wars.

description.text: 一些国家试图积极鼓励或「健康的」竞争，以确保本国工匠生产出足够多的高质量产品。这种无稽之谈只适用于一个软弱的政府。相反，我们规定了生产配额，每组工匠必须生产一定数量的商品作为税收。所以他们变得更有创造力，所以生产了更多的商品，从而他们还能致力于更大的利润。
description.text_en: Some countries have attempted positive encouragement or 'healthy' competition to ensure that their craftsmen produce enough goods of good quality. That nonsense is for a weak government. We instead have instated production quotas, where each group of craftsmen has to produce a certain amount of goods in order as a tax. So they have become more inventive to produce more goods so that they can turn a larger profit still.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿承担强邻开局压力，或只想要没有制度矛盾的纯粹英雄故事的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先守城结盟并寻找反攻窗口，中期安置难民和发展英雄机构，后期投资工业、整合新臣民并修正劳役制度。
player_overview.overview: 佉地悉罗补罗是命令秩序扩张面前仍未倒下的英雄领域。你先要守住北境，与盟友反攻并让难民返乡，随后经营英雄公会、矿山和工坊。兽人、半兽人与大地精将逐渐被纳入社会，但劳役赎罪与种姓地位也会逼问这个自称英雄的国家如何对待新臣民。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢绝境逆转、英雄叙事与多族群重建的玩家。
signature_features: 从绝境防守转为反攻命令秩序的长线战役。
英雄公会、跨族群军队和煤炭工业共同支撑国家建设。
强制劳役到自由身份的制度转折贯穿后期。
player_overview.tagline: 守住罗祆北境，把英雄、归乡难民与昔日敌人的后代带入一个重建中的国家。

reasons: 英雄领域的逆转故事有明确阶段
跨族群整合伴随制度纠偏
战争后仍有工业与公会建设
warnings: 命令秩序带来很高开局压力
英雄叙事中包含劳役和等级化矛盾

phase_scores.phase: 身份承认与废除契约劳役

positive_indicators: 保护反抗旧主的雷拳兽人
安置返乡难民并恢复战区
承认半兽人身份并最终使大地精新生者自由
values.rationale: 保护难民、接纳雷拳兽人及半兽人、最终废除大地精契约劳役有明确正面证据；旧种姓、以族群与父辈罪责安排矿山赎罪、有限期强制劳动限制总体分数。敌方Bloodsong暴行不计作R11自身罪行，也不因战争或君主制扣分。
red_flags: 兽人被要求以矿山劳动为自己及先辈赎罪
半兽人一度被排除于种姓身份之外
大地精契约劳役仍是强制制度
